findings.detection: appended event ids are lower than the ids already present in the file, breaking monotonic id ordering
findings.detail: The four new lines carry ids 548-551 but are appended after id 555 and before 556/557, so the log is no longer sorted by id and any consumer that assumes append-order == id-order (or takes max id as the last line) will misread the tail.

findings.detection: event timestamps are out of order relative to the surrounding lines
findings.detail: The new events are timestamped 2026-11-12 00:39:5x but are inserted between the 12:25:16 (id 555) and 15:01:31 (id 556) entries, so the file's timestamp ordering is also broken.

review.summary: The change only appends four board task rows and their creation events, but the events are inserted with ids 548-551 and 00:39 timestamps in the middle of a log whose surrounding entries are ids 555-557 at 12:25-15:01, breaking both id and timestamp ordering.
